# Indicator Species Analysis
library(indicspecies)

# Assuming Fun and Bac are merged phyloseq objects
indicators_fun <- multipatt(as.matrix(otu_table(Fun)), metadata_df$climate)
indicators_bac <- multipatt(as.matrix(otu_table(Bac)), metadata_df$climate)

# Visualization of indicator species
plot(indicators_fun)
plot(indicators_bac)
